newsitem.title: USA: Ramsay Health to complete merger June 10.
newsitem.headline: Ramsay Health to complete merger June 10.

text.p: Ramsay Health Care Inc and Ramsay Managed Care Inc said Monday their merger will become effective Tuesday.
The companies said the merger, begun last fall, will result in Ramsay Managed becoming a unit of Ramsay Health.
The merger was previously approved by stockholders of both companies and was recently approved by Ramsay Health's lender group as part of an amendment of the terms of its existing indebtedness.
Ramsay Health also said it is continuing refinancing efforts.

In a press release, Ramsay Health chairman said, "We are very excited about the increased revenue opportunities, cost savings, and efficiencies and other benefits which will be realized as a result of the merger."
Ramsay Health is a provider of behavioral health care services, serving markets in 16 states, it said.
Ramsay Managed manages mental health services and substance abuse programs on behalf of self ers, health maintenance organizations and governmental agencies in various states, it said.
